title: feat(studio): bulk multi-select of fields in the object designer
body:
## Summary
Third and final item of the deferred Tier-2 trio — **bulk multi-select** of fields on the object-designer canvas.

- **Ctrl/⌘-click** toggles a field into the selection; **Shift-click** selects a contiguous range; a **plain click** clears the set and single-selects (drives the normal inspector).
- A **sticky bulk-action bar** appears while ≥1 field is selected: *N selected · Move to section ▾ · Delete · Clear*. "Move to section" is only offered when sections exist; it lists Ungrouped + each declared section.
- Selected rows show a check indicator + ring. The selection is **canvas-local** (no host coupling), self-prunes when fields disappear, and clears the inspector if the host-selected field was deleted.
- Read-only canvases never enter multi-select. All strings localized (en-US / zh-CN).

## Tests
+7 RTL cases: ctrl-click count, bulk delete, shift-range, plain-click clears + single-selects, read-only inert, move-to-section gating + group assignment. `metadata-admin` suite green (**109**); `tsc` + lint clean.

## Trio complete
This closes the deferred Tier-2 trio (adapted to the model):
- bulk multi-select — this PR
- conditional-required + help text + min length — #1446
- (field-level conditional *visibility* intentionally left to the view layer; not in `FieldSchema`)
